headline: Ministry of Railways files SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure for Ircon International under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Government of India, acting through the Ministry of Railways and Railway Board, filed a formal SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) disclosure with respect to Ircon International Limited, triggering obligations under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Abhishek Sherawat, Ministry of Railways, Railway Board, submitted the statutory disclosure on behalf of the President of India to NSE. The filing invokes Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations 2011, which mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses thresholds (typically 5%) or undertakes acquisitions triggering takeover code. The involvement of the President's office and Railway Board indicates a high-level GoI transaction. Ircon International is a government-owned construction and engineering enterprise under the Ministry of Railways.
